recognize_zh: 這是一張示意性的正常紅血球體積直方圖：單一對稱鐘形峰，峰頂約在 90 fL 對應 MCV，箭頭寬度標示 RDW；實線為中央 92% 族群界線，虛線分別位於 60 與 120 fL，用來計算小紅血球與大紅血球比例。
features: Schematic RBC volume histogram with frequency on the y-axis and cell volume (fL) on the x-axis
Single symmetric unimodal peak centered near 90 fL, marked as MCV
Horizontal double-headed arrow across the curve labeled RDW
Solid vertical lines bounding the central 92% of the population
Dashed vertical lines at 60 fL and 120 fL marking microcytic and macrocytic thresholds
describe_en: This figure is a schematic of a normal impedance red cell volume histogram rather than a morphologic image. It shows a single, symmetric population of red cells centered at about 90 fL, from which the MCV is derived, with the width of the distribution represented as the RDW. Solid lines mark the central 92% of the population, and dashed lines at 60 fL and 120 fL allow quantification of the percentages of microcytic and macrocytic cells. It serves as the reference against which abnormal histograms, such as the schistocyte and reticulocyte populations in TTP, are compared.
